raw.query:
WITH cols AS (
  SELECT
    bool_or(column_name = 'is_current') AS has_is_current,
    bool_or(column_name = 'is_superseded') AS has_is_superseded,
    bool_or(column_name LIKE '%\_effective' ESCAPE '\') AS has_effective,
    bool_or(column_name ILIKE '%composed%') AS has_composed,
    bool_or(column_name ILIKE '%ratio%') AS has_ratio,
    bool_or(column_name ILIKE '%measured%') AS has_measured
  FROM information_schema.columns
  WHERE table_schema = 'provenance' AND table_name = 'v_pool_latency'
), n16 AS (
  SELECT run_id, experiment, pool, window_name, sla_metric,
         p50_ms, p90_ms, p99_ms, max_ms, n_requests, source_relation
  FROM provenance.v_pool_latency
  WHERE is_current IS TRUE
    AND encoder_workers = 16
    AND sla_metric = 'encoder_delay'
), matches AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS rounded_claim_value_matches
  FROM n16
  WHERE round(p50_ms::numeric, 2) IN (123.39, 82.22)
     OR round(p90_ms::numeric, 2) IN (123.39, 82.22)
     OR round(p99_ms::numeric, 2) IN (123.39, 82.22)
     OR round(max_ms::numeric, 2) IN (123.39, 82.22)
)
SELECT cols.*, matches.rounded_claim_value_matches,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM n16) AS current_n16_rows,
       (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(n16) ORDER BY experiment, window_name, run_id) FROM n16) AS per_window_breakdown
FROM cols CROSS JOIN matches
